questions.questionTextEn: Money multiplier is the ratio between?
questions.explanation: High powered money is the amount that is available with commercial banks in the form of reserves and with the public in the form of currency (notes and coins). The said power is the basis for expansion of currency bank deposits and creation of money supply. The money supply changes directly with changes in the monetary base and inversely with changes in the currency and Reserve Bank ratios. High Power money Equation- H=C+RR+ER Where, C=Currency RR=Required Reserve ER=Excess Reserve The lower the rates of the above, the higher the supply of high power money. High power money supply can be directly controlled by the central bank. Money multiplier (M3/M0) and high power money are always equal to money supply i.e. M=m.H Reddy Committee (1998) denoted high power money by M0 which according to Chakraborty Committee (1985) is known as reserve currency, base currency, primary currency. (M0 is the net monetary liability of the RBI.) The money multiplier shows the relationship between an increase in reserve money (RM) and an increase in the total money supply 142. What is determined by money multiplier? (a) Total supply of money in the economy. (b) High powered money. (c) Components of money supply. (d) Employment and production in the above question. UGC NET- II Paper Dec.2004 Ans. : b(b) High powered money is determine by money multiplier.
